design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: MSD Rules & Regulations require BMPs to treat a water quality volume based on runoff from 1.14 inches of rainfall. Structural BMP design methodology adopts Chapters 3 and 5 of the Maryland Stormwater Design Manual (2000). Flood detention: release rates not to exceed allowable 2-year and 100-year 24-hour events (NRCS TR-55).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: MSD requires BMPs to treat WQv from 1.14 in rainfall; structural BMP design defers to Maryland Stormwater Design Manual (2000) Ch. 3–4. WQv also defined as storage for 90th-percentile daily rainfall per MSD Rules 4.080.02. Infiltration basin DA ≤10 ac, trench ≤5 ac; open-channel/swale BMPs ≤5 ac DA; ponds ≥10 ac; wetlands ≥25 ac. Channel protection: extended detention for 1-year 24-hour event. Example appendix shows WQv in cu ft only, not depth.
